answer.summary: Two toolbar viewport tests at 1400px fail because the 'Go to next page' pagination button is never found (element not found after 15s), not a timing flake. Both tests have zero flake history, and the change touches the pagination and threat-arsenal list toolbar files (PaginationComponentV2.tsx, ThreatArsenalList.tsx), so the change most likely hides or moves that control at this width. The log doesn't show the cause directly; the failure screenshot would confirm it.
